method: Built-in OpenAI image generation, requested by the TopoPlay operator
description: Stylized educational fossil sprites; illustrative game artwork, not scientific reconstruction diagrams. Pteranodon is a pterosaur. Existing T. rex remains unchanged.
prompt_common: Transparent RGBA fossil game sprites; warm ivory and tan fossilized bones, darker brown crevices, museum-style shaded bone illustration, entire skeleton contained, no ground/slab/sand/shadow/glow/text/watermark, holes between bones transparent.

subjects.triceratops.png: Complete side-view Triceratops skeleton with three horns, neck frill, four legs and tail.
subjects.pteranodon.png: Complete Pteranodon pterosaur skeleton with spread wings, long toothless beak, rear crest, elongated wing fingers, short tail, no membranes.
subjects.fossil-cluster.png: Three separate complete skeletons in one grouping: Triceratops, Stegosaurus and small bipedal theropod, separated without overlap.
